question: What auspicious subject concerning time does the speaker now wish to hear?
premises: The speaker now wishes to hear something.
That something is the deception of time.
That subject is described as auspicious.
inference: The speaker now wishes to hear the auspicious account of the deception of time.
uncertainties: The content of that account is not provided in this verse.
plain_english: Now I wish to hear the auspicious deception of time.
